title: Exercise 6: A Deliberately Flawed deploy.sh
description: The second file in the audit exercise. Its own comments mark each defect, and it is labeled deliberately flawed, do not copy.

steps.description: This is `deploy.sh`, the second file in the audit. Line 2 marks it as `DELIBERATELY FLAWED, do not copy`.
`set -x` echoes every command with its expanded values. Its own comment is the defect note: it echoes every command plus the expanded secret.
`read -p "Deploy now? [y/N] " ok` waits for input. Its own comment is the defect note: it hangs forever in CI, where there is no human to answer.
The deploy passes `--api-token GLOBAL_KEY`. Its own comment notes the credential is over-broad: a global key, not a scoped token.

steps.question: The exercise asks you to name which single defect you would fix first if you could fix only one. How many defects are there in total?
